The deceased have been identified as Chand Kumar and Davinder Singh of Talwandi Chaudharian village and Sahil Kumar of Bidhipur village of the district. All the deceased were in their 20s. title: Kanchanjunga Express accident in Bengal: Several trains cancelled, diverted; repair work continues
text_snippet: Several trains were cancelled or diverted on Tuesday, June 18, after the Kanchanjunga Express accident that resulted in nine deaths and over 25 injuries, according to officials. A cargo train rammed into Kanchanjunga Express, a passenger train, near New Jalpaiguri station.
